reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Protecting human autonomy and decision control
themes.definition: AI threatens the autonomy of human thought and free will through manipulation, and humans must retain control over (legally binding) decisions.
themes.inclusion: Include passages warning that AI manipulates human thought or that humans, not AI, must control decisions.
themes.exclusion: Exclude military human-control debates (AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS) and catastrophic loss-of-control risk (AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL).
themes.boundary_cases: Manipulation via social platforms tied to democracy may also be coded AI_DISINFORMATION.

examples.quote: The main challenge for the democratic world in the coming decades will be whether artificial intelligence or humans control decisions.
We must not allow artificial intelligence rather than humans to take legally binding decisions. Humans must retain control.
protecting the autonomy of human thought to be the most important task for legal policy in the coming decades

themes.label: Privacy, surveillance and data rights
themes.definition: AI and data collection threaten privacy and freedom via surveillance and facial recognition; new legal and ethical principles are needed to protect rights.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on personal data, surveillance, privacy or legal principles to protect rights from AI risks.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic cyber security threats without a rights dimension.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls on the UN to lead data-protection standards also get AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: In recent times the use of facial recognition has been increasing, and we are coming under constant surveillance.
avoid risks and damage to human rights and freedoms

themes.label: UN promoting data and ethics standards
themes.definition: The UN should actively promote discussion of ethical and legal standards on data, referencing SG digital cooperation reports.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for the UN or SG processes to lead AI/digital standard-setting.
themes.boundary_cases: References to SG's High-level Panel on Digital Cooperation count.

examples.quote: The United Nations must therefore actively promote the discussion of personal data protection in cyberspace

themes.label: AI preserving small languages
themes.definition: AI used to develop machine translation that safeguards small languages and linguistic diversity.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on AI for language preservation or linguistic diversity.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general cultural diversity statements without AI.
themes.boundary_cases: National AI companies' language projects also fit AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: developing a high-quality machine translation programme for small languages using artificial intelligence

themes.label: Inclusive digital transformation
themes.definition: Digital transformation must include all countries and people, bridging the digital divide.
themes.inclusion: Include calls to bridge the digital divide in AI/digital transformation contexts.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages without an inclusion element.
themes.boundary_cases: Generic digital divide statements adjacent to AI discussion are included.

examples.quote: We must also ensure that the digital transformation is inclusive of all countries and all people, while bridging the current digital divide.

value.rationale: Latvia's passages focus on AI's threat to human autonomy and privacy (manipulation, surveillance, AI decision-making) and call for legal principles and UN leadership, with a positive minority theme on AI translation for small languages.
